# Copilot instructions

Follow `AGENTS.md` at the repository root and read `README.md` for requirements.
Substantial AI HTML/CSS assistance is welcome in this project. The student chooses
and analyzes the reference, directs revisions, and personally verifies the result.
Work iteratively; do not claim visual success or invent student observations.
Keep the comparison viewer and `do_not_modify/` intact. Use vanilla HTML/CSS.
Fence generated or substantially rewritten regions with AI comments containing the
prompt summary, and log all AI assistance in `citations.html`. Preserve citations.
